name: Palo Verde
summary: Palo Verde searched for reactor-antineutrino disappearance at approximately kilometre baselines in Arizona. Its shallow-site segmented detector and background methods tested electron mixing at the atmospheric oscillation scale.
detection_principle: Gadolinium-loaded segmented liquid scintillator detects the prompt positron and delayed neutron capture from inverse beta decay. Reactor-off periods and a signal/background swap technique constrain correlated cosmic backgrounds.
